data.comment: Implementation notes: (1) playRealtime now wraps the per-event sendToDaemon loop in try/catch and reports a new actionable 'cannot reach the instrument daemon' error (code: daemon_unreachable in --json) that names the mid-stream daemon failure and suggests --output/--fallback; every Note On still carries its auto-release length so no note is left held. (2) yargsMain no longer re-dispatches a matched command handler's rejection through parseArgs: a handlerEntered guard plus the yargs fail-callback error surface the real error/exit code, while the parseArgs fallback still serves genuinely unmatched commands. AC5(b) is satisfied at the observable level: the file positional reaches the handler intact and the fabricated 'requires a MIDI file path' error is impossible for a valid invocation. Docs updated: docs/modules/instruments.md, docs/modules/midi-import.md, and the instrument play --help text. Tests: src/cli.instrument.play.integration.test.ts (mid-stream stub-daemon disconnect, JSON error shape, unchanged healthy streaming message) and new src/cli.yargs.fallback-dispatch.test.ts. Changed-scope test run (resolved to full suite, no test groups configured): PASS.
